verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of a data-export feature, snapshot/restore mechanism, bulk-export API, or open-format (e.g., JSON/CSV) data portability path for leaving Elasticsearch. While the underlying REST/JSON API implies some data accessibility, nothing in the pack explicitly addresses exporting all indexed data in an open format for migration away from the product. Missing for 10: documented export/reindex/snapshot APIs, explicit open-format guarantees, and any hands-on confirmation of a full data migration workflow.
